summary.title: Online Store Scheme
summary.description:
Aplikasi Toko Online - Threat Model

Sistem e-commerce dengan React Frontend, Node.js REST API, MySQL Database, 
Redis Cache, Email Service, dan Payment Gateway Integration (Midtrans/Xendit).

KOMPONEN UTAMA:
- 3 External Actors: Customer, Admin, Payment Gateway
- 4 Processes: React Frontend, Node.js API, Email Service, Auth Module
- 2 Data Stores: MySQL Database (AES-256 encrypted), Redis Cache (TTL 1800s)
- 10 Data Flows dengan protokol HTTPS TLS 1.2+, SSL/TLS, SMTP TLS
- 3 Trust Boundaries: Internet, DMZ, Internal Network

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS:
1. Authentication: JWT-based dengan RBAC, MFA untuk admin, session timeout 15 menit
2. Data Protection: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, bcrypt password hashing
3. Payment Security: HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, server-side confirmation, idempotency key
4. Audit Logging: Comprehensive logging untuk semua actions, immutable records, 1-year retention
5. Input Protection: Parameterized queries, input validation, output encoding, CSP headers

IDENTIFIED THREATS: 9 total (5 CRITICAL, 3 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM)
MITIGATIONS: 52 total (20 CRITICAL, 25 HIGH, 7 MEDIUM priority)

Threat Model dibuat: 2026-09-22 | Owner: Security Team - JIS

threats.title: Tampering Data Harga Produk
threats.description: Attacker dapat mengubah harga produk di frontend sebelum melakukan pembayaran
threats.mitigation:
Server-side Price Validation (WAJIB)
- Priority: Critical

Recalculate Total Price di Backend
- Priority: Critical

Digital Signature pada Order Data
- Priority: High

Database Audit Logging untuk Price Changes
- Priority: Medium

Business logic, authentication, order processing

threats.title: Information Disclosure - Kebocoran Data Customer
threats.description: Attacker dapat mengakses data customer yang sensitive melalui API endpoint yang tidak ter-protect
threats.mitigation:
Encrypt Sensitive Data at Rest (AES-256)
- Priority: Critical

Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Priority: Critical

Data Masking pada API Responses
- Priority: High

Parameterized Queries (Prevent SQL Injection)
- Priority: Critical

Encrypt Database Backups
- Priority: High

threats.title: Denial of Service (DoS) - Server Overload
threats.description: Attacker dapat overload server dengan request volume tinggi
threats.mitigation:
1. Rate Limiting - 10 requests per minute per IP, exponential backoff - CRITICAL
2. CAPTCHA untuk Forms Sensitive - Google reCAPTCHA v3 atau hCaptcha - HIGH
3. DDoS Protection - CDN dengan built-in DDoS (CloudFlare, AWS CloudFront) - HIGH
4. Database Connection Pooling - limit 20-50 connections, timeout 30 seconds - HIGH
5. Request Queuing & Throttling - Bull queue, Redis-based queue - MEDIUM
6. Email Rate Limiting - max 5 emails per minute per user - MEDIUM
7. Web Application Firewall (WAF) - AWS WAF, ModSecurity, atau CloudFlare WAF - HIGH

threats.title: Elevation of Privilege - Unauthorized Admin Access
threats.description: Regular user dapat mengakses admin functions atau escalate privilege mereka
threats.mitigation:
1. JWT Role-Based Authorization
include role dalam JWT, verify di setiap endpoint - CRITICAL
2. Authorization Middleware
verify user role sebelum handler execute - CRITICAL
3. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) untuk Admin
TOTP atau U2F key - CRITICAL
4. IP Whitelisting untuk Admin Panel
restrict ke office/VPN IP - HIGH
5. Audit Logging untuk Admin Actions
log CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE - HIGH
6. Admin Session Timeout
15 menit inactivity, require re-authentication - MEDIUM
7. Principle of Least Privilege 
Super Admin, Product Manager, Order Manager roles - HIGH

threats.title: Repudiation - User Deny Transaksi
threats.description: User dapat menyangkal bahwa mereka melakukan transaksi tertentu karena tidak ada proof
threats.mitigation:
1. Comprehensive Audit Logging
user_id, action, IP, user_agent, timestamp - HIGH
2. Transaction Signing
HMAC-SHA256(transaction_data + user_secret) - HIGH
3. Immutable Transaction Records
append-only logs, no UPDATE/DELETE - HIGH
4. Email Confirmation
send confirmation untuk setiap transaksi penting - MEDIUM
5. 2FA untuk Sensitive Actions
require OTP jika amount > threshold - MEDIUM
6. Device Fingerprinting
log user_agent, IP, device fingerprint, geolocation - MEDIUM

threats.title: Command Injection - Email Header Injectio
threats.description: Attacker dapat inject commands di email headers untuk spam atau unauthorized distribution
threats.mitigation:
1. Email Header Sanitization
remove newlines, carriage returns, semicolons - HIGH
2. Input Validation
name: max 100 chars, alphanumeric + spaces only - MEDIUM
3. Use Safe Template Engine
Handlebars, EJS dengan automatic escaping - HIGH
4. SPF, DKIM, DMARC Configuration
prevent email spoofing - HIGH

threats.title: Spoofing Identitas User - Session Hijacking
threats.description: Attacker dapat mencuri JWT token melalui XSS atau network sniffing untuk mengakses akun user
threats.mitigation:
Token Expiration (JWT: 30 menit)
- Priority: Critical
- Status: Open

HttpOnly & Secure Cookie Storage
- Priority: Critical

Token Rotation Strategy
- Priority: High

CSRF Protection (SameSite=Strict)
- Priority: High

XSS Prevention & CSP Headers
- Priority: Critical

data.name: MYSQL DATABASE
data.description: Primary data storage: users, products, orders, transactions (AES-256 encrypted)

threats.title: SQL Injection Attack
threats.description: Attacker dapat inject SQL commands melalui unsanitized input untuk mengakses atau memodifikasi database
threats.mitigation:
1. Parameterized Queries (WAJIB)
gunakan ? placeholder atau named parameters - CRITICAL
2. Input Validation & Sanitization
whitelist allowed characters - CRITICAL
3. Use ORM Framework
Sequelize, TypeORM, atau Prisma dengan query builder - HIGH
4. Database Least Privilege
app user hanya SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE (no DROP/ALTER) - HIGH
5. Error Handling
hide database details, log server-side, return generic error - HIGH
6. WAF Rules untuk SQL Injection
ModSecurity, AWS WAF SQL patterns - MEDIUM
7. Regular Penetration Testing
monthly SAST, quarterly manual testing - HIGH

threats.title: Tampering Transaksi Pembayaran
threats.description: Attacker dapat memanipulasi status transaksi pembayaran tanpa benar-benar melakukan pembayaran
threats.mitigation:
1. Webhook Signature Verification (HMAC-SHA256)
verify setiap webhook - CRITICAL
2. Server-side Payment Status Verification
query payment provider untuk confirm - CRITICAL
3. Idempotency Key
unique key per payment, reject duplicate requests - HIGH
4. Transaction Timeout
auto-cancel pending setelah 15 menit - MEDIUM
5. Merchant Key Rotation
change key setiap 6 bulan, support dual key - MEDIUM
6. Payment Transaction Logging
log amount, status, timestamp, webhook result - HIGH
7. Fraud Detection System
alert jika amount > threshold atau unusual pattern - MEDIUM
